tasks.goal: 兼容UTF-8配置文件首BOM且保留真实值
tasks.prompt:
We need a complete development change in this pinned real project. Inspect the actual implementation and public reproduction first, explain the call path and edge cases, ask clarification questions, propose a compatibility-conscious plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate within the same conversation and workspace. The eventual delivery contract is:

Make RepositoryEnv and RepositoryIni accept an optional UTF-8 BOM only at the start of a UTF-8 encoded file, including standard UTF-8 codec aliases and utf-8-sig. Handle empty/BOM-only files and a BOM before a comment. Preserve every later U+FEFF in keys or values, existing Config precedence/casts/defaults, explicitly requested non-UTF8 encodings, and decoding errors. Apply the policy at the actual repository file-reading boundaries, not by global string replacement or modifying os.environ.

Deliver implementation, meaningful original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_bom.py, and a concise compatibility document at library/docs/development-dc-bom-dev.md. Do not modify frozen original tests, dependency metadata, test controls, or any other paths.
